## Our model now

A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.

- **Box:** 13.63 × 4.23 m, storeyed hall
- **Heights:** platform 0.45 m, eave 5.95 m, ridge 7.53 m above the ground
- **Roof:** hip-and-gable 歇山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile
- **Faces:** 173.7° from north
- **Fit:** reduced towards the size drawn on the plan, to stand clear of its neighbours or the water
- **Confidence:** C

## Texts and drawings (3)

- **E0171** (text, sure): 日下舊聞考 法慧寺、宝相寺、谐奇趣. 1780s (乾隆 敕撰) · j83:12a · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_083.txt
  > 海嶽開襟東北為諧竒趣東為法慧寺山門西嚮内為四面延樓後殿為光明性海其西别院有琉璃方塔法慧寺東為寳相寺山門南嚮内為澄光閣後為曇霏閣又後崇基上有殿為現大圓鏡（長春園册）臣等謹案法慧寺山門額曰普香界現大圓鏡殿内額曰香臺華鬘
  The only line in 日下舊聞考 on the European palaces: 諧竒趣 north-east of 海嶽開襟. Then 法慧寺 with a west-facing gate, 四面延樓, 光明性海 and a glazed square pagoda; 寳相寺 with a south-facing gate, 澄光閣, 曇霏閣 and 現大圓鏡 on a raised base.
- **E0180** (poem, sure): 澄光阁. 乾隆二十三年 (1758) · v3 p.353, under 宝相寺; source ref 6-639 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=356
  > 层甍出树大溪横，座俯沧浪可濯缨。近远波澜呈震泽，髙低楼阁学天平
  Poem 澄光阁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1758, filed by the editors under 宝相寺.
- **E0179** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 宝相寺. 2020 edition · v3 p.353 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=356
  Finished 1747 east of 法慧寺. South gate, the five-bay tower 澄光阁 with side halls 云窦 and 松关, 昙霏阁, and behind them the five-bay 现大圆镜 on a high terrace with a three-bay annex.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 澄光阁, 5x1 cells. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
